mapper.insert: insert into sys_governance_task_log (task_type, severity, count_value, action_type, handler_id, handler_name, handler_note, action_time) values (#{taskType}, #{severity}, #{countValue}, #{actionType}, #{handlerId}, #{handlerName}, #{handlerNote}, #{actionTime})
mapper.select: select log_id, task_type, severity, count_value, action_type, handler_id, handler_name, handler_note, action_time from sys_governance_task_log where task_type = #{taskType} order by action_time desc
